annotations.title: France gross-to-net salary and employer cost calculator (salaire brut net)

description: French private-sector gross-to-net salary (salaire brut → net), mainland France, 2026 rules, CDI or CDD, full-time or part-time (temps partiel): employee contributions, net pay, net taxable pay, optional tax withholding (prélèvement à la source), RGDU reduction, employer cost (executive/cadre contributions included). For a CDD: end-of-contract bonus (prime de précarité), paid-leave indemnity, CPF-CDD, monthly average and contract total. Use when a user asks for the net salary from a gross salary in France (CDI or CDD, full-time or part-time), the total cost of an employee for the employer, the end-of-contract bonus of a fixed-term contract, or the amount of employer and employee social contributions. Deterministic code, no LLM: uses URSSAF's official payroll engine (modele-social). Official 2026 rates re-applied by hand in tests, official RGDU formula and example, and 30 cases checked on the official URSSAF salary simulator (15 full-time CDI, 15 CDD and part-time). Not supported (refused for free with HTTP 422): temporary agency work (intérim), CDD à objet défini, fixed-term contracts ended early, overtime, incomplete months, fixed-days (forfait jours), apprentices and interns, company officers (SAS president), Alsace-Moselle, overseas departments, salaries below the minimum wage (SMIC, prorated for part-time), years other than those listed. Price: 0.005 USDC per successful call, paid with x402 over MCP. Missing or invalid fields are reported for free with the questions to ask the user; you never pay for an error. Returns JSON (also in structuredContent): calculateur, resultat, detail (step by step), hypotheses, bareme (version, effective date, sources), estimation_indicative, avertissement, lien_verification. Full output schema and a real example: list_france_calculators.

cas_particuliers.description: Required. Special situations that apply, or [] if none: interim (temporary agency work), cdd_objet_defini (CDD à objet défini), cdd_rupture_anticipee (CDD ended before its term), forfait_jours (fixed-days arrangement), heures_supplementaires (overtime this period), mois_incomplet (incomplete month, absence, sick leave), apprenti_stagiaire (apprentice or intern), dirigeant_assimile_salarie (company officer), alsace_moselle, outre_mer (overseas department), prevoyance_avec_part_salariale (provident scheme with employee share), avantages_en_nature (benefits in kind), exoneration_specifique (specific employer exemption), deduction_forfaitaire_specifique (specific flat-rate deduction). Any listed situation is refused for free (HTTP 422).

cdd_duree_mois.description: Required for a CDD: total contract length in months (0.25 to 36, e.g. 1.5 for six weeks).

cdd_job_vacances_jeune.description: Required for a CDD: true for a school or university student’s holiday job (no end-of-contract bonus).

cdd_jours_conges_pris.description: Required for a CDD: paid-leave days taken during the contract, in working days (0 if none). Untaken leave is paid as a 10 % indemnity at the end.

cdd_motif.description: Required for a CDD: reason for the fixed-term contract: accroissement_activite (temporary increase in activity), remplacement (replacing an absent employee), saisonnier (seasonal work: no end-of-contract bonus, no CPF-CDD), usage (CDD d’usage: no end-of-contract bonus).

cdd_suivi_d_un_cdi.description: Required for a CDD: true if the CDD is immediately followed by a CDI with the same employer (no end-of-contract indemnities).

effectif.description: Company headcount band: moins_de_5 (under 5), de_5_a_10, de_11_a_19, de_20_a_49, de_50_a_149, de_150_a_249, 250_et_plus.

mois.description: Required if periode = mois: payroll month 1 to 12.

mutuelle_part_patronale.description: Monthly employer share of the company health insurance (mutuelle), in EUR (0 if none).

mutuelle_part_salariale.description: Monthly employee share of the company health insurance (mutuelle) on the payslip, in EUR (0 if none).

periode.description: mois (monthly gross salary) or annee (annual gross salary).

salaire_brut.description: Gross salary in EUR for the period (monthly or annual, see periode), including bonuses paid in the period.

statut_cadre.description: true if the employee has executive status (cadre).

taux_atmp_pourcent.description: Optional: workplace accident insurance rate (taux AT/MP) of the establishment, in percent. If omitted, the national average (2.08 %) is used; it only affects employer cost.

taux_prelevement_source_pourcent.description: Optional: employee income tax withholding rate (taux de prélèvement à la source), in percent. If given, the withholding and net pay after tax are returned.

taux_versement_mobilite_pourcent.description: Required if the company has 11 or more employees: transport levy rate (versement mobilité) of the workplace municipality, in percent (0 if none).

temps_partiel_heures_par_semaine.description: Optional: weekly hours for a part-time employee (1 to 34.99). Omit for full-time (35 h). The minimum wage check and the RGDU are prorated.

type_contrat.description: CDI (permanent contract) or CDD (fixed-term contract). A CDD requires periode = mois and the cdd_* fields.
